title: EasyBoost Lite
body:
![EasyBoost - Lite Edition](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a3534d96f64a7049842bc8276d271d854f83942_0.webp) Want a version with more features? Check out [EasyBoost](https://modrinth.com/modpack/easyboost)
# EasyBoost Overview **EasyBoost Lite** is a lightweight, optimised, Fabric-based modpack designed to enhance and improve your Minecraft Experience both in singleplayer and multiplayer, all whilst providing a stable framerate # Features ✅ **Optimised Performance** - Smooth inputs and stable framerates
✅ **Broad Compatibility** – Supports Minecraft 1.21+ and works with almost all modpack-supported launchers

Always use the latest version of **EasyBoost Lite** for the best performance
